acquisition_method: Full MS scan over the mass-to-charge (m/z) range of 300–1750 with a resolution of 120,000, followed by data dependent acquisition with an isolation window of 2.0 m/z and a dynamic exclusion time of 30’s was performed.
alkylation_concentration: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer) and incubated for 30 min at room temperature, followed by centrifugation.
alkylation_reagent: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer) and incubated for 30 min at room temperature, followed by centrifugation.
cleavage_agent: Filter units were transferred to new collection tubes and proteins were resuspended in 40 μL DB with Trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) for overnight proteolytic digestion at 37°C.
collision_energy: The top 12 ions were fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27% and scanned over the m/z range of 200–2000 with a resolution of 15,000.
enrichment_method: We demonstrate that density-based fractionation of urine by bottom-up Optiprep density gradient centrifugation separates EV and soluble proteins with high specificity and repeatability.
fractionation_method: We demonstrate that density-based fractionation of urine by bottom-up Optiprep density gradient centrifugation separates EV and soluble proteins with high specificity and repeatability.

instrument: Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer

Equal amounts of peptides of each sample (500 ng) were loaded on a nanoflow HPLC system (Easy-nLC1000, Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nano‐electrospray ionization source.

ptm: Carbamidomethyl (C), oxidation (M) and acetylation of the protein N-terminus
Carbamidomethyl (C), as a fixed modification, and oxidation (M) and acetylation of the protein N-terminus as dynamic modifications were included.
